Hero_Desc_Bana:
The blacksmith of the Werebeast Village.
Vana likes to fix small items and often modifies them without permission.
She dreams of forging a hero's sword someday.
Album_Like_Bana: Machines with many flaws. The heat rising from the furnace.
Album_Hate_Bana: A problem that's too simple. Lazy fire elementals slacking off inside the forge.
Album_Wish_Bana: Becoming a legendary blacksmith worthy of storybooks.
Album_Bana1: Bana is the best blacksmith in the Werebeast Village when it comes to handling fire. Her craftsmanship is excellent, and she can fix even the smallest things with ease. However, since she always adds strange modifications, her reputation remains average.
Album_Bana2: Bana's personality completely changes when she works. She yells so loudly that Lesser Elementals of water, fire, earth, and wind freeze in place, unable to move. I wonder if the Noble Elementals are aware of this.
Album_Bana3: When I asked if she was being too harsh on the Lesser Elementals, Bana laughed and said that the Noble Elementals actually approve of it. Apparently, after working here for a few days, the Lesser Elementals start listening to their higher-ups much better.
Album_Bana4: Nothing excites Bana more than an Overheated Shoupabolt. She once mentioned wanting to install around twenty cargo compartments on it. Shoupan complains that Bana always looks at her Shoupabolt with suspiciously greedy eyes.
Album_Bana5: Sometimes, I spot empty chow cans rolling around in Bana's Forge. They belong to Kommy, who often forgets them when she visits the warm place. It turns out Bana eats them too sometimes, saying, "Kommy doesn't know the joy of roasted food." I even caught her heating a can over the fire.
Album_Bana6: Bana dislikes Mago's ranch. When the animals lick her curly hair, it gets so heavy that it weighs her down unbearably. But even worse, birds try to build nests in it. Well, I can see why—Bana's hair does look incredibly fluffy.
Album_Bana7: Bana's tools have intricate engravings on them. I asked how she managed to carve such delicate designs, and she silently opened her mouth. Inside, I saw gleaming, sharp front teeth. Suddenly, the glossy finish on her recent engravings made a lot of sense, and I instinctively took a step back.

Food_ChefNote_Bana_Hate1: Vana grimaced, recalling a time she mistook something for pomegranate and chipped her front tooth.
Food_ChefNote_Bana_Hate2: Vana wrinkled her nose at the strong scent and pushed the cup away.
Food_ChefNote_Bana_Like1: Vana eagerly devoured it, saying it's not something that can be stored for long in the forge. It seems she liked the strawberry decoration.
Food_ChefNote_Bana_Like2: Vana enjoyed the crunchy texture, munching away happily. Could they be used as food for teeth grinding?
Food_ChefNote_Bana_Like3: Vana chewed the treat for a long time, enjoying the texture. Though, it seems she bit her tongue. She mumbled about wanting another bowl.
Food_ChefNote_Bana_Like4: Vana marveled at the idea of a sweet log, then reluctantly gave a piece to a Lesser Fire Elemental. She was very reluctant to share.
Food_ChefNote_Bana_Like5: After sweating a lot, Vana craved something sour and licked it eagerly.
Food_ChefNote_Bana_Like6: Vana was startled that it didn't melt in her mouth, and had to be told to chew it.
Food_ChefNote_Bana_Like7: Vana savored both almonds and chocolate, declaring them both delicious.
Food_ChefNote_Bana_Like8: Sticking out her tongue and licking it, Vana enjoyed the popping sensation in her mouth, but spilled a lot of powder. She licked it clean.
Food_ChefNote_Bana_Like9: Vana tried to store it in her cheeks like a squirrel. She had to be told to eat it quickly.

LoveLetter_Bana:
I am sorry I always come to the banquet hall covered in grime and dirty the tablecloth and floor. Thank you for feeding me instead of throwing me out. 

I do not have a gift for you, but should I repair the banquet hall oven? With the right modifications, I might even make it dispense hot iced Americanos. I cannot promise it will work, though. Want to try? Give me permission anytime, and I will come running with my hammer!
LoveCall_Bana:
Master! What are you doing? If you are taking a break, want to visit the smithy?
After hammering away for days and days, I finally completed an amazing sword!
It is not quite the legendary weapon I have always dreamed of making... but I still put a lot of work into it!
I do not show it to just anyone, you know. I called to tell you first because you are the Master~

I hope you will watch over my journey toward becoming a legendary blacksmith!
When you cheer me on, I feel like I can definitely make it!
Thank you for always encouraging me. I truly mean it! Hehe, why does saying that feel a little embarrassing?

So hurry over! I will even shell sunflower seeds for you.
I am already excited just thinking about playing with you again after so long!
I will be waiting!
